title: Five months, Godot and AI tools: my bullet heaven about my dog has a free demo
author: Cookiesaner
selftext:
I'm a gamer who wanted to make a game myself, so I made one about my real dog, Cookie. It's COOKIESANER, a bullet heaven. Solo, Godot 4, five months, from May 13 to October 20.

Claude Code wrote the GDScript. I tested every change in the game before keeping it. The art comes from Gemini and Higgsfield. Gemini can't give a clean transparent background, so every sprite goes through a background removal step. The music is made with Suno. Her barks are recorded from her. The design and every choice in it are mine.

One thing that didn't make the cut: AI walk frames. Her legs are rigged on single drawings now.

In the game she fires ćevapi, eats to get bigger, hits harder and moves slower. At stage 4 she goes GOD MODE and rolls over the horde. Two maps, three bosses, about 10 minutes a run.

Free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4816480/?utm\_source=reddit&utm\_medium=post&utm\_campaign=aigamedev  
Browser, no download: https://cookiesaner.itch.io/demo

Let me know what you guys think, I'd appreciate any suggestions :)
